sql.code:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE age BETWEEN 18 AND 30;      -- 含端点
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE city IN ('北京','上海');
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE name LIKE '张%';            -- % 任意多字符，_ 单个字符
sql.content: BETWEEN 含两端端点；IN 替代多个 OR；LIKE 做模糊匹配（% 任意长度，_ 单字符）。LIKE '%x' 开头通配无法走索引，大表慎用。
sql.title: BETWEEN / IN / LIKE
